goal: Fail closed when stored local replay payloads violate the status/result/resolution contract

baseline.defect: After a completed local job result was directly replaced with the structurally invalid JSON array [], inspect returned it as a successful completed result.
baseline.observed: baseline_accepts_corrupt_result True; status completed; control_unchanged True

acceptance_criterion: completed accepts only an object result with the known integrity schema and no resolution
abandoned accepts only an object resolution with worker_stopped=true and no result
running publishes neither result nor resolution
invalid replay fails closed without resetting or mutating control and without recomputation
installed CLI exits 2 with clean JSON and no traceback
commands: python3 - <<'PY'  # disposable SQLite baseline corruption fixture
python3 -m unittest nasuraya_continuity_kit.test_local_job nasuraya_continuity_kit.test_store continuity.test_gate project_fund.test_planner -v

stderr_json.error: invalid local job state; no reset

actual_result: Local replay now rejects invalid JSON and structurally inconsistent running/completed/abandoned payload combinations before returning a result or recomputing work.
uncertainty: The fixtures cover deliberate structural corruption, not every disk, power-loss, or hardware fault.
A tampered object that still satisfies the checked structural fields is outside this patch.
The wheel was built once; no two-build reproducibility claim is made.
Reliability evidence is not evidence of awareness or model-weight change.
scoped_lesson: Durable replay must validate the stored state/payload contract, not merely parse JSON.
next_unfinished_step: Operator review of stacked draft PR #41 remains pending. In a future admitted run, inspect new failures first and do not repeat this completed structural-payload check without new evidence.
summary_fa: من replay محلی را fail-closed کردم: نتیجه یا resolution ذخیره‌شده‌ای که با قرارداد وضعیت سازگار نیست دیگر موفق بازگردانده نمی‌شود. خط پایه پذیرش آرایهٔ نامعتبر را نشان داد؛ سپس ۵۲ آزمون، نصب آفلاین و CI همان commit روی Python 3.11 و 3.12 موفق شدند. ادغام، تغییر مجوز یا اقدام مالی انجام ندادم.
